note: Adapted from Maiti & Chakraborty 1994, original in English (Records of the Zoological Survey of India, Occasional Paper No. 167). Type locality Nicobar: Nancowry; the holotype soldier (ZSI registration No. 3169/H11), paratype soldiers (3170/H11) and 3 paratype dealate alates plus 5 pseudoworkers (3171/H11) are deposited in the ZSI, Calcutta, and 1 further soldier and 2 pseudoworkers in the F.R.I. Dehra Dun. The original gives the measurements as a table, and the OCR placed the labels and the values of the second half of the alate table in two separate text blocks, which are matched here in the original row order; the original gives the eye-ocellus distance as Nil. Obvious OCR misprints in the descriptions (comers=corners, dialated=dilated, froms=frons, apilose=hairless) have been read from the context; the name of the comparison species appears in the original as both parvisculatus and parviscidatus and has not been made uniform. Not translated: the figures of the wing venation and wing scales (Fig. 2 a–d).

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: This species is closely related to Neotermes blairi sp. nov. from the South Andamans and to N. parvisculatus Light and N. andamanensis Snyder. Differences from N. parvisculatus: the alate head is smaller, head length (to the tip of the labrum) 1.58–1.63 mm and head width (including the compound eyes) 1.73–1.81 mm (in the latter head length 1.70 mm, head width 2.10 mm); the Y suture is faintly discernible (indiscernible in the latter); antennal segment 3 is slightly longer than segment 2 (in the latter segment 3 is about as long as segment 2). The soldier head is narrower, head index (width/length) 0.72–0.82 (the latter has a broader head, index 0.89); the left mandible has 5 distinct marginal teeth (only 3 in the latter); the postmental waist is slightly less than half the maximum width (far less than half in the latter). Differences from N. andamanensis: the alate antennal segment 3 is slightly longer than segment 2 (in the latter segment 3 is slightly shorter than segment 2), and the ocelli are larger (smaller in the latter). The soldier is smaller, head length 2.14–2.43 mm, head width 1.76 mm (in the latter head length 2.58–3.26 mm, head width 2.02–2.42 mm); the mandibles are long, distinctly more than half the head length, mandible-head length index 0.66–0.67 (in the latter the mandibles are short, only slightly longer than half the head length, index 0.53–0.61); marginal teeth 4 and 5 of the left mandible are close together with only a weak notch between them (separated in the latter, without a notch, only a shallow depression).

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Coloration: head capsule red-brown to dark brown; antennae and labrum yellowish brown; pronotum paler than the head capsule; abdominal tergites pale brown; sternites pale yellow; legs golden yellow to yellowish brown. Head and pronotum rather densely hairy, the abdominal tergites and sternites sparsely hairy. Head capsule nearly circular, wider than the mandible length; the Y suture faintly visible in weakly sclerotized specimens, invisible in dark specimens; the frons slightly inclined anteriorly. Compound eyes rather large, nearly circular, close to the antennal base and far from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli oval, semi-transparent, touching the compound eye, their distance from the antenna about equal to their long diameter. Postclypeus distinct, flat and narrow, almost without a boundary with the frons, the same colour as the head capsule, with a few setae. Anteclypeus nearly trapezoidal, white and hairless. Antennae incomplete; segment 2 about half of segment 1, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segments 2 and 3 more strongly sclerotized, segment 4 the shortest and the following segments gradually longer. Labrum broadly dome-shaped, wider than long. Mandibles of the Neotermes type: left mandible with one rather long apical tooth and 2 shorter marginal teeth, the posterior edge of marginal tooth 1 equal to the anterior edge of marginal tooth 2; right mandible also with one apical tooth and 2 marginal teeth, the apical tooth finger-shaped, marginal tooth 1 triangular, marginal tooth 2 short, its anterior edge longer than the posterior edge of the molar region. Pronotum flat, slightly wider than the head; the anterior margin distinctly concave; the posterior margin slightly concave; the anterolateral corners narrowly rounded, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded. Wing scales dark brown; the fore wing scale does not overlap the hind wing scale; within the fore wing scale the tibial vein, subcosta, media and cubitus arise independently; the radius and the radial sector arise from a common stalk and separate near the wing suture. Legs short and stout, tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented; with an empodium. Abdomen elongate, the posterior margins of the tergites with long setae. Measurements (mm, 5 dealate alates): head length to the tip of the labrum 1.96–2.14; head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 1.58–1.63; maximum head width (including the compound eyes) 1.73–1.81; maximum diameter of the compound eye 0.58–0.63; minimum diameter of the compound eye 0.53–0.60; distance from the compound eye to the lower margin of the head 0.18–0.29; maximum diameter of the ocellus 0.24–0.29; minimum diameter of the ocellus 0.15–0.21; eye-ocellus distance 0 (Nil. in the original); maximum length of the postclypeus 0.20–0.29; maximum width of the postclypeus 0.76–0.82; maximum length of the labrum 0.29–0.48; maximum width of the labrum 0.58–0.72; pronotum length 0.96–1.14; pronotum width 1.75–1.91; fore wing scale length 1.38–1.48; hind wing scale length 0.58–0.63.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellowish brown, slightly darker in front; antennae and labrum pale yellow; pronotum and legs pale yellow; abdomen yellowish white. Head, thorax and abdomen sparsely hairy. Body length (excluding antennae) 7.85–8.10 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular, much longer than wide; posterior margin nearly straight; the sides nearly parallel, very slightly narrowing anteriorly; head width at the lateral base of the mandibles 1.34–1.48 mm; in lateral view the frons is distinctly inclined forward; the anterolateral corners slightly projecting. Y suture distinct. Compound eyes nearly oval, white, situated slightly below the antennal sockets. Ocelli absent. Antennae 12–13-segmented; segment 3 strongly sclerotized, slightly triangular, longer than segments 2 and 4, segment 4 the shortest, from segment 5 onward gradually longer and more slender. Postclypeus much wider than long, strongly sclerotized, the anterior margin nearly straight, the posterior margin clearly delimited from the frons, with several long erect hairs. Anteclypeus white, band-shaped, declined, anterior margin nearly straight, hairless. Labrum wider than long, the disc with several erect hairs, the anterior margin weakly convex, the sides very slightly narrowing anteriorly. Mandibles long, about two thirds of the head length, with a distinct basal tubercle. Left mandible: apical tooth curved inward, 5 marginal teeth; the inner edge at the base of the apical tooth weakly convex; marginal teeth 1 and 2 prominent and well separated, with a distinct notch between them; marginal tooth 3 indistinct, the edge between it and tooth 2 concave; a deep depression between teeth 3 and 4; teeth 4 and 5 blunt and close together, the notch between them indistinct. Right mandible: apical tooth curved inward, 2 stout marginal teeth, both with a short anterior and a long posterior edge, well separated, with an angular notch between them, the posterior edge of marginal tooth 2 curved inward. Postmentum long, rod-shaped, swollen at the anterior third, with a very weak notch in the middle of each side; the posterior two thirds narrow, the minimum width almost half the maximum width; the anterior margin nearly straight, the posterior margin weakly convex, the swollen part with several hairs. Pronotum flat, slightly narrower than the head, about as long as wide; the anterior margin broad and deeply concave; the sides weakly convex; the posterior margin convex with a weak median depression; the margins and disc sparsely hairy. Legs short and stout, tibial spur formula 3:3:3. Abdomen elongate, the tergites and sternites sparsely hairy. Measurements (mm, 4 soldiers, holotype/range): head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 2.34/2.14–2.43; maximum head width 1.76/1.76; maximum head height 1.34/1.30–1.38; head index (width/length) 0.71/0.71–0.82; maximum labrum length 0.19/0.15–0.19; maximum labrum width 0.40/0.38–0.40; left mandible length 1.63/1.43–1.63; mandible-head length index (left mandible length/head length) 0.69/0.63–0.69; median minimum postmental length 1.72/1.53–1.72; maximum postmental width 0.65/0.64–0.65; postmental waist width 0.30/0.26–0.30; maximum pronotum length 0.92/0.72–0.92; maximum pronotum width 1.58/1.43–1.65; pronotum-head index (pronotum width/head width) 0.90/0.81–0.94; pronotum index (length/width) 0.58/0.46–0.61; number of antennal segments 13/12–13.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker (abbreviated Psw. in the original). Head capsule, antennae and labrum pale yellow; thorax cream-yellow; abdomen and legs cream-white. Head and body moderately hairy. Body length (excluding antennae) 5.86–6.43 mm. Head capsule nearly circular, wider than long; eye spot oval, unpigmented. Antennae 12-segmented, segment 2 almost as long as segment 3, segment 4 about half of segment 3 and the shortest segment, from segment 5 onward gradually longer. Postclypeus slightly flat, almost without a boundary with the frons, the posterior margin weakly concave, sparsely hairy. Anteclypeus transversely broad, hairless, the anterior margin weakly concave. Labrum much wider than long, the sides diverging anteriorly, the apical margin nearly straight, the dorsum rather convex, with several erect hairs concentrated at the tip. Mandibles of the Neotermes type. Pronotum flat, half as long as wide; the anterior margin broadly concave, without a median notch; the anterolateral corners narrowly rounded, the posterolateral corners broadly rounded; the posterior margin with a weak median depression; the disc with scattered small hairs. Legs short and stout. Abdomen elongate, hairy. Measurements (mm, 10 pseudoworkers): head length to the lateral base of the mandibles 1.30–1.43; maximum head width 1.30–1.40; maximum head height 0.85–0.90; maximum labrum length 0.43–0.45; maximum labrum width 0.48–0.50; maximum pronotum length 0.57–0.68; maximum pronotum width 1.19–1.24.
